import { attachControl, setCameraLimits } from "@babylonjs/lite";

  canvas: HTMLCanvasElement,
  scene: SceneContext,
  minDistance: number,
  maxDistance: number
): () => void {

    lowerRadiusLimit: minDistance,
    upperRadiusLimit: maxDistance,

}
